## Setup

```{r}
#| label: install
#| eval: false
install.packages(c("igraph", "tidyverse", "ggraph", "tidygraph", "rgexf", "jsonlite"))
```

```{r}
#| label: libraries
library(igraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-graph
library(rgexf)
library(jsonlite)

gexf_obj <- read.gexf("citation_graph.gexf")
g <- gexf.to.igraph(gexf_obj)
g <- as.directed(g, mode = "arbitrary")

bib <- fromJSON("bibliography.json", simplifyDataFrame = FALSE)

node_attrs <- tibble(
  name       = names(bib),
  title      = map_chr(bib, ~ if (!is.null(.x$title)) .x$title else ""),
  year       = map_chr(bib, ~ if (!is.null(.x$date)) .x$date else if (!is.null(.x$year)) .x$year else ""),
  generation = map_chr(bib, ~ if (!is.null(.x$generation)) .x$generation else ""),
  entry_type = map_chr(bib, ~ if (!is.null(.x$entry_type)) .x$entry_type else ""),
)

cat("Nodes:", vcount(g), "\n")
cat("Edges:", ecount(g), "\n")
cat("Directed:", is_directed(g), "\n")
```

## Degree

```{r}
#| label: degree
V(g)$degree_in  <- degree(g, mode = "in")
V(g)$degree_out <- degree(g, mode = "out")
V(g)$degree_all <- degree(g, mode = "all")

degree_df <- tibble(
  name       = V(g)$name,
  in_degree  = V(g)$degree_in,
  out_degree = V(g)$degree_out,
  degree     = V(g)$degree_all,
) |> left_join(node_attrs, by = "name")
```

### Most cited

```{r}
degree_df |> arrange(desc(in_degree)) |> head(20) |>
  select(name, title, year, generation, in_degree) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### Most citing

```{r}
degree_df |> arrange(desc(out_degree)) |> head(20) |>
  select(name, title, year, generation, out_degree) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### Degree distribution

```{r}
#| label: degree-dist
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(degree_df, aes(x = in_degree)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "In-degree distribution (log-log)",
    x = "In-degree (times cited)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Centrality

```{r}
#| label: centrality
V(g)$betweenness  <- betweenness(g, directed = TRUE, normalized = TRUE)
V(g)$closeness_in <- closeness(g, mode = "in", normalized = TRUE)
V(g)$pagerank     <- page_rank(g, directed = TRUE)$vector
V(g)$hub          <- hub_score(g)$vector
V(g)$authority    <- authority_score(g)$vector

centrality_df <- tibble(
  name        = V(g)$name,
  betweenness = V(g)$betweenness,
  closeness   = V(g)$closeness_in,
  pagerank    = V(g)$pagerank,
  hub         = V(g)$hub,
  authority   = V(g)$authority,
  in_degree   = V(g)$degree_in,
) |> left_join(node_attrs, by = "name")
```

### Top by betweenness

```{r}
centrality_df |> arrange(desc(betweenness)) |> head(20) |>
  select(name, title, year, betweenness) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

### Top by PageRank

```{r}
centrality_df |> arrange(desc(pagerank)) |> head(20) |>
  select(name, title, year, pagerank) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 6)
```

### Top by authority score

```{r}
centrality_df |> arrange(desc(authority)) |> head(20) |>
  select(name, title, year, authority) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

### PageRank by generation

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
centrality_df |>
  filter(!is.na(generation), generation != "") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = generation, y = pagerank, fill = generation)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "PageRank by generation",
    x = "Generation",
    y = "PageRank (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Connected Components

```{r}
#| label: components
wcc <- components(g, mode = "weak")
scc <- components(g, mode = "strong")

cat("Weakly connected components:", wcc$no, "\n")
cat("Largest WCC size:", max(wcc$csize), "\n")
cat("\nStrongly connected components:", scc$no, "\n")
cat("Largest SCC size:", max(scc$csize), "\n")

V(g)$component_weak   <- wcc$membership
V(g)$component_strong <- scc$membership
```

### WCC size distribution

```{r}
tibble(size = wcc$csize) |>
  count(size) |>
  arrange(desc(size)) |>
  head(20) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Community Detection

```{r}
#| label: undirected
g_undirected <- as.undirected(g, mode = "collapse")
```

### Girvan-Newman

```{r}
#| label: girvan-newman
#| cache: true
# Note: slow on large graphs — may take several minutes
gn <- cluster_edge_betweenness(g_undirected)
cat("Communities:", length(gn), "\n")
cat("Modularity:", modularity(gn), "\n")
V(g)$community_gn <- membership(gn)

tibble(size = sizes(gn)) |>
  arrange(desc(size)) |>
  head(20) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### Louvain

```{r}
#| label: louvain
louvain <- cluster_louvain(g_undirected)
cat("Communities:", length(louvain), "\n")
cat("Modularity:", modularity(louvain), "\n")
V(g)$community_louvain <- membership(louvain)

tibble(size = sizes(louvain)) |>
  arrange(desc(size)) |>
  head(20) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: louvain-viz
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12
#| cache: true

tg <- as_tbl_graph(g) |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  mutate(community = as.factor(V(g)$community_louvain))

ggraph(tg, layout = "drl") +
  geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.05, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_node_point(aes(colour = community), size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  theme_graph() +
  labs(title = "Citation graph — Louvain communities")

ggsave("bibvik_louvain.png", width = 16, height = 16, dpi = 300)
ggsave("bibvik_louvain.pdf", width = 16, height = 16)
```

### Leiden

```{r}
#| label: leiden
leiden <- cluster_leiden(g_undirected, objective_function = "modularity")
cat("Communities:", length(leiden), "\n")
V(g)$community_leiden <- membership(leiden)

tibble(size = sizes(leiden)) |>
  arrange(desc(size)) |>
  head(20) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## K-Means Clustering

```{r}
#| label: kmeans
features <- centrality_df |>
  select(betweenness, closeness, pagerank, hub, authority, in_degree) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0))) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ scale(.)[,1]))

set.seed(42)
k <- 6
km <- kmeans(features, centers = k, nstart = 25)
centrality_df$cluster_kmeans <- km$cluster
V(g)$cluster_kmeans <- km$cluster

cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
table(km$cluster) |> print()
```

### Cluster profiles

```{r}
centrality_df |>
  group_by(cluster_kmeans) |>
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    mean_pagerank    = mean(pagerank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_betweenness = mean(betweenness, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_authority   = mean(authority, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_in_degree   = mean(in_degree, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 5)
```

## Export

```{r}
#| label: export
node_table <- centrality_df |>
  left_join(
    tibble(
      name              = V(g)$name,
      component_weak    = V(g)$component_weak,
      component_strong  = V(g)$component_strong,
      community_gn      = V(g)$community_gn,
      community_louvain = V(g)$community_louvain,
      community_leiden  = V(g)$community_leiden,
      cluster_kmeans    = V(g)$cluster_kmeans,
    ),
    by = "name"
  )

write_csv(node_table, "bibvik_node_table.csv")
cat("Written bibvik_node_table.csv\n")
```
